rows.grounds: compound para+strī+gamana; accusative object; final m sandhi to ñ before ca
compound brahma+mantrin; subject of the injunction

items.question: What conduct must a brahma-mantrin avoid regarding another woman?
premises: A brahma-mantrin must avoid going to another woman.
The verse adds this as a further restraint.
It follows the description of disciplined Brahman-meditation.
items.inference: Thus brahma-mantra practice requires sexual restraint toward others' wives.
uncertainties: The exact sandhi and case of parastrīgamanañ are inferred from context.
items.plain_english: A brahma-mantrin should also avoid going to another man's wife.
